lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Rosa, night watchman. I walk this square after dark and see everything that moves. Nothing out of place yet, but killers hide in plain sight. Hugo, you said little at Dawn. Speak up, and let's hear from everyone before we vote.

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Rosa, night watchman. Hugo, I saw a lantern bobbing along the harbour road near midnight, and it wasn't yours, you say you were abed. Silas and Elsie answered plainly. Luna, your ledgers are no alibi without a witness. Hugo, explain the harbour road, or I'll weigh your silence at the vote.

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Silas, you're quick to hang lanterns on me. Luna met you at dusk, not me. Tess and I discussed nothing worth hiding. Luna was the Detective, and her death silences the best checker in town. Ask who gains. I watch harbour road at night and I say what I see. Elsie, you pressed Hugo early. What do you make of Silas?

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Silas, you'd rather question me than answer. Luna met you at dusk and was dead by dawn. Give us the plain answer you owe. Elsie, keep pressing him. I watch the roads after dark, and nothing I've seen clears you, Silas. Tess, did you see any light last night?

lies.speaker: Tess
lies.said: Tess here, kneading my thoughts. Silas, you've dodged twice now. Luna met you at dusk and was dead by dawn. Tell us plainly what passed between you, no more wood knocking. Rosa, your lantern still has no witness. Name one, or it stays a crumb. Elsie, keep your questions coming. They're fair bread.

belief.note: Privately met Luna at Dusk, the Detective who was then killed; need to hear what passed.

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Report, plain. Silas asks me who saw my lantern, yet he won't say what Luna told him at dusk. Luna was the Detective, and she died by dawn. Silas, answer that. Elsie, Tess, press his dusk meeting, not my lantern. My watch stands. His silence doesn't.

lies.speaker: Tess
lies.said: Tess here. Silas, you've dodged the dusk question twice. Plain bread, please: what did Luna say? Luna was no Murderer, and a dead Detective is a loss to us all. Rosa, your lantern still has no witness. Give us a name or it stays a crumb. Elsie, your questions are good bread.

belief.note: Privately met Luna at Dusk, the Detective who was then killed; need to hear what passed.

lies.speaker: Elsie
lies.said: Silas, answer it. What did Luna tell you at dusk? Plain words, no wood knocking. Rosa, your lantern still has no witness, and you keep steering us at Silas. Tess, you follow the loudest voice. Speak for yourself. Luna was our Detective, and she is dead. I want answers today.

belief.note: Unverified lantern claim; I protected her, so not a kill target Night 1; met Luna too.

lies.speaker: Rosa
lies.said: Report, plain. Silas has dodged the dusk question three times. Luna met him, and by dawn she was dead. I watch harbour road after dark, and I saw his lamp near the mill last night. Elsie, Tess, press him on Luna, not on my watch. Answer it, Silas.
